ChangeFlag

Static Properties

ChangeFlag.APPEARANCE

Anything affecting the appearance of an item, including GEOMETRY, STROKE, STYLE and ATTRIBUTE (except for the invisible ones: locked, name)

    Type:

  • Number
ChangeFlag.CHILDREN

A change in the item’s children

    Type:

  • Number
ChangeFlag.INSERTION

A change of the item’s place in the scene graph (removed, inserted, moved)

    Type:

  • Number
ChangeFlag.GEOMETRY

Item geometry (path, bounds)

    Type:

  • Number
ChangeFlag.MATRIX

The item’s matrix has changed

    Type:

  • Number
ChangeFlag.SEGMENTS

Only segment(s) have changed, and affected curves have already been notified. This is to implement an optimization in _changed() calls

    Type:

  • Number
ChangeFlag.STROKE

Stroke geometry (excluding color)

    Type:

  • Number
ChangeFlag.STYLE

Fill style or stroke color / dash

    Type:

  • Number
ChangeFlag.ATTRIBUTE

Item attributes: visible, blendMode, locked, name, opacity, clipMask …

    Type:

  • Number
ChangeFlag.CONTENT

Text content

    Type:

  • Number
ChangeFlag.PIXELS

Raster pixels

    Type:

  • Number
ChangeFlag.CLIPPING

Clipping in one of the child items

    Type:

  • Number
ChangeFlag.VIEW

The view has been transformed

    Type:

  • Number
